name: button
title: Button
description: A Base UI button whose press scale depends on its width, whose label swaps with y + blur while the width springs, and whose loading spinner overlays the label so the width never changes. Popover triggers never scale.
docs: Import Button from components/eased/button/button. Variants: primary, secondary, ghost, danger, danger-solid. Sizes: sm, md, lg, icon-sm, icon, icon-lg. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import.
